summary: Fresh MVP for Tagkawayan Ride & Pabili tested end-to-end. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases pass (auth, catalog, ride full loop, pabili preset + custom order loop, driver online/requests/active/history, admin stats/users/role-change/orders, authz negative tests). Frontend: verified via mobile viewport (390x844) — login (email admin & phone driver), signup (phone+name), role-based routing (customer/driver/admin tabs), customer home service cards, Book-a-Ride flow with landmark picker + passenger stepper + fare estimate + tracking screen timeline, driver dashboard showing real live requests (2 rides + 1 pabili) after toggling online, admin overview stats and users list, pabili Browse Stores grid + store detail with add-to-cart + Type-a-List tab all render correctly. Cash-only payment reinforced everywhere. No red screens, no crashes, all critical testIDs present. Minor React Native web warnings detected: deprecated 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' — cosmetic, not blocking, but should be migrated.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — likely coming from SHADOW.card in src/theme.ts and any shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius usages. Not blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow (RN 0.76+) for future-proofing.
React Native Web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — check any pointerEvents prop and move it into style.
Warning: 'Animated: `useNativeDriver` is not supported' on web — expected on web preview, but if any custom Animated.timing uses useNativeDriver:true, consider platform-guarding to false on web.

action_items: (Optional polish) Migrate SHADOW.card and any shadow* style props in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (and any inline usage) to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional polish) Move any pointerEvents JSX prop into style={{ pointerEvents: ... }} to silence deprecation warnings.
No functional fixes required — MVP is production-ready for demo.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 570-line file — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers/ (auth, rides, orders, driver, admin) if features grow.
public_user() properly strips password and _id — good.
All Mongo queries use projection {'_id': 0} — good, no ObjectId leaking.
JWT_SECRET, MONGO_URL, ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD all read from env — good.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; all interactive elements have testID.
All text is wrapped in <Text>; components use View/Pressable/TouchableOpacity properly (no HTML tags).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows verified: auth, customer home, book-ride+tracking, driver online w/ live requests, admin overview+users, pabili browse+store detail)
